type: Campaign Key Visual Main Visual System
goal: Generate the main visual and proportional derivative illustrations for the iteration season of spatial computing devices, with a calm tone and a 'less is more' approach, avoiding fictional unpublished hardware model numbers.

campaign.name: Apple Vision Spatial Computing Next Chapter 2026
campaign.claim: Lift the system interface from the screen to space

visual_system.color_palette: Deep space silver + white mist + cyan purple edge light

anchor_visual.description: A sleekly designed head-mounted display device's side silhouette floating in mid-air, the mask is made of continuous curved glass, no brand engraving; surrounded by a lightweight translucent multi-window information layer, suggesting spatial UI with abstract geometries and map lines; main visual does not show actual watchOS interface screenshots
anchor_visual.composition: Equipment slightly to the left, leaving the right half for Chinese and English claims and halos

visual_system.graphic_motif: Concentric fine circles and slowly moving particles, symbolizing spatial anchor points, appearing repeatedly but with low transparency

claim_typography.font_style: Large Chinese bold font + small size English all-uppercase sans-serif.
claim_typography.color: Near white text + weak gray auxiliary small text.

items: 1:1 symmetrical crop with device mask as the center
9:16 composition with the character's hand extending into the frame (not showing the face, only showing the hand and device relationship)
16:9 large banner forming a 'ground-sky' ratio with the horizon and device silhouette
derivative_layouts.rule: Three small frame sketches at the bottom edge of the main image, labeled 1:1 / 9:16 / 16:9, corner apple leaf-shaped abstract symbol indicates unofficial

logo_placement.position: Minimalist geometric leaf shape and fine text in the lower right corner, merely for style suggestion

must_keep: The same lighting and fog effect runs through the four boxes
claim not cut off outside the safe zone
No use of real press conference stage photos for collage
avoid: Include recognizable iOS screenshots like Health app
Multiple stickers and sponsorship tags on the equipment
